stances_toward.note: Nigeria's regional force against Boko Haram and ISWAP is hollowing: the ISS (2025) judges that it has run no regional operation since July 2024, Niger has left it, and Chad has threatened to reduce or leave (Security Council Report, June 2026). Partner (a joint instrument, no alignment beyond the mandate), cooling. Bond none. Since 2024-07 is the date from which the ISS counts no regional operation, not the force's founding; the earlier 'since 2014' on the nsa-boko-haram stance comes from a search summary and is also unchecked.
